name: @fast-brake/skip-comments
description: Fast comment and string detection for JavaScript without preprocessing - checks if a position is inside a comment or string literal

scripts.build:run: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --format esm && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --format cjs --outfile ./dist/index.cjs && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
